description: A repeated timestamp inside one TS.MADD is only a duplicate-policy fold when it still lands in the bucket the rule is currently accumulating into (madd_duplicate_ts_must_not_publish_open_bucket's fz:ob4). When a later, distinct item in the same batch has since closed that bucket with a forward advance, the repeat is a genuine back-fill into already-published history and must recalculate the closed bucket (here also dropping fz:k0's ts=0 sample, which the batch's own advance to ts=2000 pushes below the RETENTION=1000 floor): reference reports count=1 (bucket [0,2000) holds only ts=1000 once ts=0 is trimmed), where classifying the repeat as a fold left ts=0 folded into the bucket alongside ts=1000, reporting count=2.
